tooltip.$description: Tooltip: a short description next to the element it describes.

enter-offset.$description: How far it comes in from its target as it appears (0: it only fades in).

surface.$description: The tooltip; `rich`: it holds more than its text (content of its own).

arrow.$description: An arrow towards the target: a square turned on its corner, centred on the edge that faces the target, the half outside the tooltip showing (`display` shows it; `size` its side; its fill and its frame continue the tooltip's).

text.$description: The text (`rich`: in a tooltip with content of its own).
